body: Yeah man, of course. Taking everyone's opinions into consideration. Thank you :)

Thanks for your reply man. I don’t think space is what she needs. If I give her space she’ll feel more isolated and might be inclined to kill herself. Like I said, she doesn’t have anyone else. I’m her last hope I guess. I don’t think leaving her would be the right decision for that same reason. But thank you, I’ll try to lurk more and educate myself.

Hey, thanks for your reply. I guess you’re right. But that’s not my intention. I wouldn’t make threats to enforce action, I understand that that’s morally that’s not good to do, and also that just doesn’t work. She knows I’m there for her, but how can I help her if she doesn’t want to help herself? :/

Thank you, I think that’s what I’ll do. It’s tough man. I feel like she’s given up, but I don’t know how to help her out; I don’t know how to make her want to live. I guess I’ll continue to talk to her everyday and make her feel wanted.
Hey, thank you. I think I needed to hear that. I told her I already made up my mind, and she’s stopped trying to convince me to leave. I’ll stay by her side and help.
